## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Module

- [ ] Collectors/data
- [ ] Schema/ontology/graph
- [ ] Retrieval/interface
- [ ] Evaluation
- [ ] Documentation

## Verification

Explain how the change was tested or reviewed.

## Evidence and data checklist

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private data, or restricted content are included.
- [ ] New records follow the shared schema and source policy.
- [ ] Third-party sources, licenses, and limitations are documented.
- [ ] Generated claims remain traceable to source evidence.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and understandable.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] At least one code owner has approved the latest revision.
